results.title: 29 Seconds to Midnight
results.overview: Two sets of brothers from South Philadelphia rob a bank on Halloween to pay for a dying brother’s cancer treatment, only to become trapped in a hellish loop when the clock strikes midnight.

results.title: He’s Dating a Boldstar
results.overview: Jeboy, a mild-mannered hotel employee, falls for a woman he believes is an ordinary guest—until he discovers she is a “bold star,” a Filipino term for an adult entertainer.

results.title: Lamina
results.overview: David spends his days sanding scars out of other people’s marble and wood, making the past look brand new again. Nights he sits outside his ex-wife’s loft like a man waiting for a ghost that never quite arrives. Then one barroom massacre changes everything. A stranger pulls him out of the slaughter a second before the shooting starts, almost like he’d seen it coming.  Now David is becoming unstuck. Moments stutter. Hours repeat. Reality folds in on itself. The stranger offers no explanations, only grim little jobs he calls the Moments. Some things, it turns out, can never be restored.

results.title: Geographies of Home
results.overview: Two brothers, one living in Mexico City and the other in Berlin, undertake an experimental audiovisual correspondence. Through a series of short video-letters, they explore their personal experiences of migration, home, and belonging. Blending found footage, family archives, original images and soundscapes, the project takes the form of an intimate visual dialogue. What begins as individual reflections gradually evolves into a collaborative process in which both brothers revise, edit, and respond to each other’s material. Rooted in visual anthropology and autoethnography, the film raises a central question: how do we construct a sense of place and belonging when we no longer live in the country of our origin? A quiet, non-linear exploration of displacement and the seek for a home.

results.title: Red Crown
results.overview: Twenty-five contestants compete for a P25 million cash prize at the 25th-anniversary "Queen of the Islands" pageant.

results.title: Burns Like A Shot
results.overview: When her best friend accidentally drinks her truth serum, a driven young scientist must reverse the effects before the unfiltered honesty between them burns down everything they've never said to each other.

results.title: It Appears in a Flash!
results.overview: A man wakes with a bloody axe in his hands. He doesn't remember who he is or the horror that haunts him. Armed only with a Polaroid camera, he's being hunted by IT, which only shows itself in a flash of light.

results.title: Brew before you cry
results.overview: In a small coastal town, a ridiculous yet suspicious fatal accident puts a widower under everyone’s watch. A claims investigator who’s been on the losing end for far too long decides this might just be his one shot at getting something right.

results.title: After the Rehearsal
results.overview: In the garden of a colonial villa in Bujumbura, five actors gather. They were summoned here to rehearse a theatre piece about a future in which all international organisations and NGOs have left East Africa. But now, as the director herself is not there, they cannot do anything but wait, and share a few stories. Nested in a mythological setup with an absent director, an unruly fictional character, a ghost and a wanderer, they tell stories about the sphere of development aid and the inequality it claims to fight.  After an essayistic introduction, their narrations drift between report, fairy-tale and gossip. In an attempt to grasp a an increasingly elusive world, these monologues were developed out of stories, ideas and experiences from 5 years of artistic research and exchange between a Burundian and a German filmmaker.

results.title: Tin Castle
results.overview: Along a long-forgotten road, the O’Reillys live in a rundown trailer stranded in the middle of the fields. Pa’, Lisa, and their ten children weather the seasons in their tin castle, heirs to a way of life on borrowed time. Under threat of eviction, their tenuous balance falters, yet – steadfast in their tradition – they resist. The children laugh, the dogs bark, the trailer holds on – but for how long?

results.title: 7 Days 7 People
results.overview: The story of Jinhwa, an indie musician at a crossroads of life, agonizing between ideals and reality as he meets seven close people around him for seven days.

results.title: The Autoharp Crushing on Hot Guys
results.overview: A conversation between friends about relationships and feelings is developed in an imaginative, colorful animation. Despite their different life experiences, which are also influenced by the fact that one of the girls has Down syndrome and the other doesn‘t, they both deal with similar issues. What if they had The Autoharp Crushing on Hot Guys.

results.title: The Child's Mother
results.overview: Set in the east German city of Halle, the documentary tells the story of Anne who became a mother at the age of 17. Her daughter Leonie, now aged 14, runs the risk of taking the same path to drug addiction. To break the cycle, Anne is determined to change her life, but can she become the role model her daughter needs before it’s too late?

results.title: Swear To Me
results.overview: Vasyl lives in a remote Carpathian village, where he bears responsibility for the household and helps his mother with traditional coverlets fulling. One evening, his younger brother Ivan arrives unexpectedly at the family home. Ivan is a gay soldier who, before being deployed to a front-line position, wishes to discuss his last will. In the event of his death, he asks to be cremated by his partner in Kyiv, rather than laid to rest in the village soil where he was never truly accepted. This request stands in direct opposition to local traditions. Vasyl finds himself torn between honoring his brother’s final wish and conforming to what is considered morally and culturally right.

results.title: Fate
results.overview: The story takes place at a tourist resort in Hurghada, where a wealthy widow inherits the resort following the death of her billionaire husband. While managing the resort, she goes through several romantic experiences in search of a suitable life partner, until she meets a man with whom she falls in love.

results.title: Words of Love
results.overview: For 14 years, Erika has been the anchor of a household that rarely stands still, doing her best to raise teenage Abigail, her whirlwind little brother, Yoni, and a dog with an extreme devotion to cheese. When Abi’s desire to meet her absent father grows into a full-blown obsession and word spreads he’s been seen nearby, Erika fears the fragile balance will collapse for good. Instead, the unpredictable journey that follows brings mother and daughter to see each other anew, steering their lively, lovable family toward a happy new chapter.

results.title: The Eyes of Ghana
results.overview: 93-year-old documentarian Chris Hesse—personal cinematographer to forgotten African icon Kwame Nkrumah—races against blindness and time to rescue and repatriate a secret trove of over 1,300 films that captured the birth of African independence in the fifties and sixties. Yet unseen by the public, these films may not only rewrite Ghanaian and African history—but world history itself.

results.title: Back to the Beginning: Ozzy's Final Bow
results.original_title: Back to the Beginning: Ozzy's Final Bow
results.overview: A powerful return to roots, this concert captures Black Sabbath in peak form - reuniting to deliver classic hits with raw energy and legendary precision.

results.title: Edhi Alice: Take
results.overview: Edhi Alice: TAKE begins from the perspective of Alice, a gaffer pushed out of the field, as she confronts her own body, and transitions into the journey of another protagonist, Edhi, who discovers a new sense of embodiment. The narrative of transition expands beyond a personal life story to encompass relationships, bodily experiences, and the sense of space, becoming a cinematic transformation.
